exception_message: Compressed file ended before the end-of-stream marker was reached
observation: The original watcher scanned a gzip stream while a concurrent focused session was still writing it. It exited before producing a scan report. The setup model session itself completed normally.
coverage_limit: In-memory credential values in this failed watcher were lost on exit. Later scans cover values still available in installed credentials or observed by another active watcher; they cannot recover earlier temporary-only values that were not observed elsewhere.
